Who We Are
 Everything at BMW TechWorks begins with passion. It transforms a job into a calling. It motivates us to continually reinvent mobility and bring new ideas to life and onto the roads. Passion for collaborative projects turns a team into a strong unit where every viewpoint is appreciated.
Whatever You Aspire To, At BMW TechWorks We Live And Breathe Software And We Offer a Wide Variety Of Departments And Fields Where You Can Share Your Professional Passion With Us. By Delivering Software All The Way From The Idea To The Final Product, We Lead BMW Into The Future Of Digitalization And Mobility. And This Also Means
We search for excellence 
We get involved

 Join BMW TechWorks on our journey of innovation and excellence as we redefine the future of motion, one product at a time. Our engineers are vital to the innovation and digitalization of BMW Group's driving machines, production, sales and banking processes, and you could be part of our evolving teams.
 What Awaits You
Managing Automotive components production environment.
Exposure to leading and high critical systems and enable production systems.
Firsthand experience to run, operate and enhance car components BMW plant.
Exposure to optimize with AI the infrastructure and codebase.
Make part of the team who will challenge legacy transformation on a AI orchestrated system with human guardrails.
Managing Linux environment on updates, releases and optimization for High Availability and reliability.
Operation, monitoring, troubleshooting activities for critical environments.
Experience on running critical application in BMW plants from first hand and posible plant visits.
 What Should You Bring Along
University Degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field)
At least 3-5 years of experience on a Linux Administrator (Suse Linux or similar enterprise level Linux distributions like RedHat, Ubuntu, Fedora)
Nice to have experience with Oracle or Postgres Database management and administration
Exposure and experience with messaging systems like: Kafka, MQ, RFC1006
Experience in Networking and troubleshooting
Knowledge to use CI/CD process with GitHub
Exposure and/or experience with Azure Cloud and AKS
Exposure and/or experience with high critical system
Experience to use AI toolset in daily work environment
Experience on system troubleshooting, monitoring with Grafana and Prometheus.
Exposure to programing language like: Python, C++, Java and bash scripting for short fixes
Excellent English verbal and written skills
German communication skills will be a plus

Challenging projects with which we are shaping the mobility of tomorrow. 
Great team spirit within an international team

Wide range of personal & professional development opportunities 
High level of job security

Attractive and performance-related remuneration 
Dynamic and highly-motivating work environment
